meta.normalization_note: Corpus states only title + a one-line restatement. Fields marked INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS are supplied by the analyst, not the corpus. Only title, original_statement and domain are FACT.

problems.title: AI-based early detection & decision-support for pearl millet diseases
problems.stated_objective: identify major pearl millet diseases early (FACT)
problems.target_users: smallholder pearl millet growers, extension officers (INFERENCE)
implicit_assumptions: a farmer will photograph a diseased plant
visual symptoms appear early enough for action to change the outcome
the recommended input is available and affordable
unknowns: is downy mildew visually detectable before yield loss is already locked in?
ambiguities: 'decision-support' undefined: diagnosis vs spray scheduling vs seed choice

problems.title: AI virtual plant pathology laboratory for diagnosis & training
problems.stated_objective: virtual lab for plant disease diagnosis and management training (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: training is the bottleneck, not access to diagnosis
unknowns: who mandates or consumes such training
ambiguities: 'virtual lab' spans simulator, courseware, and live diagnostic tool

problems.title: Honey Chain: blockchain honey traceability & smart beekeeping
problems.stated_objective: make honey traceable hive-to-consumer via blockchain + sensors (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: ledger integrity is the binding constraint on honey fraud
unknowns: does a ledger address the actual adulteration mechanism (syrup blending) at all?
ambiguities: the solution mechanism is pre-specified by the statement, foreclosing exploration

problems.title: Standardised onion quality assessment & grading at procurement centres
problems.stated_objective: standardise onion grading with computer vision and measurable criteria (FACT)
problems.target_users: procurement-centre graders, farmers delivering produce, traders (INFERENCE)
problems.stakeholders: mandi/APMC operators, commission agents, downstream buyers (INFERENCE)
problems.outputs: a grade plus a defensible justification (INFERENCE)
implicit_assumptions: disputes stem from measurement error rather than incentive conflict
unknowns: is grader subjectivity accidental, or economically motivated?
ambiguities: the dispute-resolution mechanism is unspecified
problems.note: One of only two statements that names a symptom (disputes, inconsistency) rather than a technology.

problems.title: Early detection, prevention & management of livestock disease
problems.stated_objective: help farmers detect, prevent and manage livestock disease early (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: detection is the bottleneck rather than veterinary reach
unknowns: ratio of detection failure to response failure
ambiguities: species unspecified; scope enormous

problems.title: Low-cost IoT blockchain nodes for farm-to-fork traceability
problems.stated_objective: affordable connected nodes capturing trusted supply-chain data (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: the oracle problem is solvable with cheap hardware
unknowns: who pays for node deployment, and why they would
ambiguities: mechanism pre-specified

problems.title: AI food packaging material recommendation
problems.stated_objective: recommend packaging materials per commodity using AI (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: material selection is a knowledge problem, not a cost or supply problem
unknowns: is this a lookup table dressed as AI?
ambiguities: recommendation aimed at packer, brand, or regulator?

problems.title: Academia-industry portal for skill mapping, internships, placement
problems.stated_objective: connect academic talent and industry needs (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: matching is the bottleneck
unknowns: why the many prior portals failed
ambiguities: extremely saturated category

problems.title: Vernacular pedagogy & real-time translation for mother-tongue primary education
problems.stated_objective: mother-tongue learning and live translation for primary education (FACT)
problems.target_users: primary teachers in multilingual classrooms, and children (INFERENCE)
implicit_assumptions: translating existing material is equivalent to mother-tongue pedagogy
unknowns: classroom device availability; the teacher's own proficiency in the child's language
ambiguities: 'real-time translation' of teacher speech, of textbooks, or of child speech?
problems.note: The statement conflates translation (a text operation) with pedagogy (a practice). Rich ambiguity.

problems.title: Automated ASPECTS scoring for acute ischemic stroke
problems.stated_objective: compute ASPECTS from brain imaging and present an explainable result (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: ASPECTS is the decision bottleneck in the stroke pathway
unknowns: where the real delay sits in the door-to-needle timeline
ambiguities: deployment site: comprehensive stroke centre vs district hospital
problems.note: Heavily commercialised space with multiple regulator-cleared products.

problems.title: AI early detection of osteoarthritis risk markers
problems.stated_objective: identify early OA risk markers and support preventive intervention (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: early identification changes outcomes
a preventive intervention exists and is actually delivered
unknowns: what clinical action follows a positive result
ambiguities: 'risk marker' vs 'diagnosis'

problems.title: Explainable AI for diabetic retinopathy screening in rural India
problems.stated_objective: explainable retinal image analysis for rural screening programmes (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: grading accuracy is the binding constraint on screening programmes
unknowns: referral completion rate after a positive screen
ambiguities: explainability for whom: clinician, patient, or regulator?
problems.note: Among the most saturated medical-AI categories in existence.

problems.title: Breath-based detection device for drug consumption
problems.stated_objective: non-invasive breath analysis to detect drug consumption (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: target analytes partition into breath at detectable concentration
unknowns: sensor chemistry feasibility at low cost
ambiguities: which drugs; enforcement use vs clinical use
problems.note: Hardware-dominant; not prototypeable on a software timeline. Also carries civil-liberties considerations that must be designed for, not ignored.

problems.title: Patient case-taking software
problems.stated_objective: streamline structured patient history collection (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: structure is desirable to the clinician, not only to the system consuming it
unknowns: who actually reads the structured record
ambiguities: extremely broad; overlaps the entire EMR industry

problems.title: AI solution for farmer procurement wait times, schedule information, and status uncertainty
problems.stated_objective: reduce farmer uncertainty about procurement schedules, queues and payment status (FACT)
problems.stakeholders: procurement-centre staff, transporters, state agencies, commission agents (INFERENCE)
implicit_assumptions: the information exists somewhere and is merely not distributed
unknowns: whether queue position is genuinely determined by arrival order
ambiguities: three distinct problems bundled: waiting, information, and payment status
problems.note: One of only two statements written as an observed symptom. Names concrete, checkable pain.

problems.title: AI-based fraud detection in digital transactions
problems.stated_objective: detect suspicious transactions quickly while reducing customer friction (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: a team can obtain representative transaction data
unknowns: data access
ambiguities: issuer-side vs merchant-side vs consumer-side
problems.note: Mature industrial field; data access is close to disqualifying for an external team.

problems.title: Digital payment system for farmers & rural economy
problems.stated_objective: trustworthy, accessible payments for rural communities (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: a new payment rail is what is missing
unknowns: what existing rails already cover
ambiguities: rail vs interface vs trust layer

problems.title: Interoperability among government digital platforms
problems.stated_objective: reduce fragmented public service delivery via secure integration (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: fragmentation is technical rather than jurisdictional
unknowns: access to any real government system
ambiguities: unbounded scope
problems.note: Cannot be validated or demonstrated without institutional access.

problems.title: AI-based cyber threat detection
problems.stated_objective: identify emerging threats from network, endpoint and application signals (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: public datasets reflect real environments
unknowns: realistic evaluation data
ambiguities: overlaps the entire SIEM/XDR industry
problems.note: Saturated; the standard benchmark datasets are known to be unrepresentative.

problems.title: Secure digital identity & authentication system
problems.stated_objective: a resilient identity system that keeps access simple (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: a newly built identity system is adoptable
unknowns: the trust anchor
ambiguities: unbounded
problems.note: Building new identity infrastructure is not credible at prototype scale.

problems.title: AI real-time women safety alert system
problems.stated_objective: a rapid, consent-driven alert system for unsafe situations (FACT)
problems.target_users: women in transit and public space (INFERENCE)
implicit_assumptions: alerting is the bottleneck
somebody responds to the alert
unknowns: what happens after an alert fires
ambiguities: 'consent-driven' is a meaningful and unusually careful qualifier
problems.note: Panic-button apps are extremely saturated and have documented low sustained usage.

problems.title: Safe route recommendation system
problems.stated_objective: routes using context-aware safety signals, accessibility and real-time conditions (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: route safety is predictable from available signals
reported crime data reflects actual danger
unknowns: signal source; reporting bias
ambiguities: safety for whom, at what hour
problems.note: Crime-data-driven routing carries documented bias and feedback-loop risks.

problems.title: Women safety system in public transport
problems.stated_objective: improve safety on buses, trains and stations through connected reporting and response workflows (FACT)
problems.target_users: women commuters, transit staff, control-room operators (INFERENCE)
implicit_assumptions: reports are made, and are then acted on
unknowns: the existing transit complaint pathway and its completion rate
ambiguities: 'response workflow' is the interesting half and is left unspecified
problems.note: This statement uniquely names the response side, not only detection.

problems.title: Simulation-based high-altitude optimisation & robust design of anti-drone system
problems.stated_objective: use simulation to optimise high-altitude performance and robust anti-drone design (FACT)
unknowns: access to validated aerodynamic / RF models
ambiguities: defence context; dual-use considerations
problems.note: Requires domain physics validation that a general team cannot obtain or check.

problems.title: AI identification, classification & prediction of tropical cyclone patterns from multi-source satellite data
problems.stated_objective: identify, classify and predict tropical cyclone patterns from multi-source satellite data (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: ML will beat operational numerical and Dvorak-style baselines
unknowns: which baseline is actually being beaten
ambiguities: 'prediction' of intensity, track, or genesis?
problems.note: Data is genuinely public and abundant, and baselines are strong and well published. That makes honest evaluation possible, which is unusual in this corpus.

problems.title: Adaptive path planning & collision avoidance on unstructured Indian roads
problems.stated_objective: safe navigation where road structure, traffic and obstacles are unpredictable (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: a vehicle platform exists to test on
unknowns: how to evaluate without a vehicle
ambiguities: full autonomy is out of reach; sub-problems are not
problems.note: Simulation-only demonstrations are weakly persuasive in this domain.

problems.title: Pollution-aware navigation
problems.stated_objective: routes balancing time, distance, congestion and pollution exposure (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: street-level pollution is knowable at routing resolution
unknowns: spatial resolution of available air-quality data versus road-network resolution
ambiguities: exposure (inhaled dose) versus ambient concentration - materially different objectives
problems.note: The dose-versus-concentration distinction is a real and under-addressed technical gap.

problems.title: AI windshield installation guidance system
problems.stated_objective: computer vision identifies the windshield area, displays predefined pressure-application points, guides the operator to apply adequate pressure sequentially at each point, tracks completion of all points, and confirms immediately that the standard process was followed (FACT - fully specified)
problems.outputs: point overlay, sequence tracking, completion confirmation (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: pressure adequacy is observable from vision alone
unknowns: how 'adequate pressure' is measured without a force sensor
ambiguities: display target left deliberately open: projection on glass, monitor, or AR headset
problems.note: THE ONLY FULLY SPECIFIED STATEMENT IN THE CORPUS. It also contains an explicit unsolved sub-problem: vision-based force verification.

problems.title: AI early warning & landslide risk monitoring
problems.stated_objective: combine environmental signals and terrain data to warn communities about landslide risk early (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: a warning leads to evacuation
unknowns: last-mile warning delivery and community response
ambiguities: regional susceptibility mapping versus site-specific imminent warning - very different problems
problems.note: The 'warn communities' half is far less explored than the prediction half.

problems.title: Automated urban parcel mapping & cadastral feature extraction
problems.stated_objective: extract urban parcels and cadastral features from geospatial data with AI-assisted review (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: parcel boundaries are visually inferable
unknowns: divergence between legal boundary and physical boundary
ambiguities: 'AI-assisted review' implies a human in the loop but does not specify the loop

problems.title: Intelligent land record digitisation & validation
problems.stated_objective: turn legacy land records into searchable, validated, trustworthy digital records (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: OCR quality is the bottleneck
unknowns: what 'validated' means in legal terms
ambiguities: digitisation versus adjudication of conflicting claims
problems.note: Validating a land record is a legal act, not a software act. That tension is the interesting part.

problems.title: Kabadiwala Connect - bringing the informal collector into the formal recycling chain
problems.stated_objective: bring informal waste collectors into a more visible, efficient and fair recycling chain (FACT)
problems.stakeholders: scrap dealers, recyclers, municipal bodies, brands with EPR obligations (INFERENCE)
implicit_assumptions: formalisation benefits the collector
collectors want to be visible
unknowns: whether visibility helps or harms an informal operator
ambiguities: 'fair' undefined; 'formal' may threaten the very actor it claims to help
problems.note: The statement contains a genuine internal contradiction worth attacking: formalisation can destroy informal margin. Under-templated, and the stakeholder is genuinely neglected.

problems.title: AI-powered assembly inspection system
problems.domain: Smart Cities & Urban Development (mislabelled; actually manufacturing)
problems.stated_objective: verify manufacturing assembly quality with computer vision, AI and optional wearable AR (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: defects are visually distinguishable
normal examples are abundant while defect examples are not
unknowns: defect data availability
ambiguities: presence/absence checking versus true defect detection

problems.title: AI-powered manufacturing operations assistant
problems.domain: Smart Cities & Urban Development (mislabelled; actually manufacturing)
problems.stated_objective: help factory teams understand constraints, validate plans, detect risks and keep production moving (FACT)
implicit_assumptions: plan validity is checkable from available data
unknowns: access to a real factory's constraint model
ambiguities: assistant versus scheduler versus alerting system
problems.note: 'Validate plans' implies a formal constraint model - the most technically interesting phrase in the manufacturing trio.

problems.title: Open innovation challenge
problems.stated_objective: propose an original solution to a meaningful problem within one of the themes (FACT)
problems.note: Not a problem. It is a wildcard slot that inherits the themes above. Its analytical value is that it removes the constraint of matching a pre-written statement, permitting a problem reframed during ground-reality research.
